text: sorry this is probly me being daft but my husbands at work and i cant decide if im overthinking. my little boy Theo is 5 months and hes teething really badly, dribbling everywere, his left cheek is bright red and hes chewing on anything he can grab, my fingers, his blanket, the remote lol. temp was 38.4 under his arm about 20 mins ago. the thing thats bugging me is his crying, its not his normal cry at all, its sort of thin and high and weak and it just keeps going and going, like a constant whiny noise rather than his proper angry cry. i keep telling myself its his teeth. also i realised when i changed him just now that his nappy was totaly dry and when i think about it i dont think hes had a wet one since this morning, so thats over 12 hours. his colour looks fine, hes not pale or anything and his lips are normal pink. i dont want to waste anyones time if this is just teething but i thought id better check
